tools.name: insider_signals_today
tools.description: Rule-2 insider-buy signals filed today (SEC code P open-market purchases), ranked cluster-first. Each record carries its source filing_url.

tools.name: insider_signals_by_ticker
tools.description: All Rule-2 insider-buy signals for one ticker (case-insensitive). Each record carries its source filing_url.

tools.name: insider_signals_by_date_range
tools.description: Rule-2 insider-buy signals filed within an inclusive ISO date range. Each record carries its source filing_url.

tools.name: insider_cluster_buys
tools.description: Rule-2 cluster buys only (>=2 insiders buying the same issuer in-window) — the highest-signal subset. Each record carries its source filing_url.

tools.name: insider_filing_lookup
tools.description: The single Rule-2 record for one SEC filing accession, with its filing_url. Returns an error if no gated filing matches the accession.

tools.name: federal_awards_recent
tools.description: Recently signed U.S. federal new awards from USAspending.gov, newest first. Optional min_amount (USD floor) and limit. Every award carries its source award_url; awards without a source link are dropped and never returned.

tools.name: activist_stakes_recent
tools.description: Recent activist Schedule 13D / 13D-A filings on US-listed companies, newest first then by stated-intent strength (control/take-private > board/proxy > strategic/value, or none stated). Optional min_percent (percent-of-class floor), ticker, and limit. Every stake carries its source filing_url; filing
